name: Børk the Berzerker Hack ‘N’ Slash Edition
review:
A barbarian on a mission to rescue his beloved from an evil magician, on five reels with expanding wilds and a bonus game. It's a comedy fantasy with plenty of Thunderkick charm.

The 97.3% RTP is well above average, and the cap is a modest 2,100x. Thunderkick publishes a number for volatility rather than a label, so we don't show a rating. A good-value game for long sessions.
pros: Excellent 97.30% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Thunderkick doesn't publish a volatility label for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
